bootstrapAssessment.reason: Current host lacks the matching open-source compiler, native SDK/linker and execution environment. Large toolchain downloads were not substituted for an executable native implementation and test path. Availability of downloadable tools means Android cross-compilation can be provisioned later; it is not an intrinsic platform impossibility.

architecture.dependencyConstraint: Native adapter targets may adopt DiscordMedia and foundational Core/Transport as needed; portable Media/VoiceCodecs must not import native frameworks or gain concrete-adapter dependencies.
architecture.injectedBoundaryLimitation: A new generic backend protocol or conditional module excluded on macOS would not implement missing native I/O, permission, route or interruption behavior. No nominal targets, placeholder adapters or uncompiled native calls were introduced.

compilePrerequisites: Install an open-source Swift toolchain and exactly matching Android Swift SDK; the installed Xcode compiler is not the documented matching toolchain.
Install the Android NDK and configure its toolchain/sysroot/linker; the current official guide specifies NDK LTS r30.
Compile the full native adapter target for aarch64 and x86_64 at the adopted Android API floor.
nativeImplementation: Use owned AAudio C calls to open independent input/output streams, select device IDs and verify actual sample format, channel count, rate and selected ID after opening.
Implement bounded preallocated callback buffers and cross-thread ownership; close streams only after callback use has ended, never from the AAudio error callback thread.

Use a small owned JNI/host boundary for AudioManager device enumeration/change notifications and audio focus, app lifecycle and explicit RECORD_AUDIO runtime permission result. AAudio does not provide enumeration, automatic endpoint routing or runtime permission UI.
Fail closed on route loss, disconnection, interruption, denied/revoked permission or focus loss; require explicit restart and keep host foreground-service/background policy explicit.
qualification: Run permission grant/deny/revoke, route replacement/unplug, interruption/focus loss and capture/playback cancellation on an Android app/device.
Measure bounded queues and duplex PCM under actual callbacks. Cross-compilation alone does not qualify routing or hardware.

compilePrerequisites: Provide a Windows Swift 6.4-or-newer toolchain, MSVC C++ build tools and Windows SDK on a Windows execution host.
Compile an owned WASAPI/COM bridge and Swift adapter against actual SDK interfaces before exposing the product.
nativeImplementation: Enumerate and resolve endpoint IDs through IMMDeviceEnumerator; activate IAudioClient and initialize capture/render streams with explicit format/routing validation.
Use IAudioCaptureClient/IAudioRenderClient with bounded buffers and a serialized COM/native-thread lifetime; release each acquired buffer and interface on every failure and stop path.
Handle device invalidation and IMMNotificationClient/IAudioSessionEvents notifications without deadlocking COM callback threads.
Represent microphone privacy/capability denial accurately for the embedding app model; do not equate generic Windows desktop privacy settings with an Apple-style permission prompt.
qualification: Run endpoint selection, privacy denial, default-route replacement, hot unplug, session disconnection and cancellation on Windows.
Run actual full-duplex capture/playback with bounded queue accounting. SDK headers alone do not qualify COM/native-thread ownership or hardware.
